mapper.select: SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(r_price) AS total FROM recipt WHERE r_u = #{value} AND DATE(r_date) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND CURDATE() GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ORDER BY dt

SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(r_price) AS total FROM recipt WHERE r_u = #{value} AND r_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 27 DAY) AND r_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ORDER BY dt

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(r_price) AS total FROM recipt WHERE r_u = #{value} AND r_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND r_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym

SELECT u.gender AS gender, ROUND( IFNULL(SUM(r.r_price), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.u_id), 0) , 0) AS total FROM user u LEFT JOIN recipt r ON r.r_u = u.u_id AND r.r_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND r.r_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender
SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(daily_sum)), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(r_price) AS daily_sum FROM recipt WHERE r_u = #{value} GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(daily_sum)), 0) FROM ( SELECT DATE(r_date) AS dt, SUM(r_price) AS daily_sum FROM recipt GROUP BY DATE(r_date) ) t
